create_OwlViTProcessor: create an OwlViTProcessor instance with an image processor and tokenizer for zero-shot object detection
call_OwlViTProcessor: call the OwlViTProcessor to tokenize text and preprocess images returning input_ids, attention_mask, and pixel_values
post_process_OwlViTProcessor: post_process OwlViTProcessor output to convert model predictions into final bounding boxes with confidence scores
post_process_grounded_object_detection_O: post_process_grounded_object_detection on OwlViTProcessor to convert raw detection output into bounding boxes with text labels
post_process_image_guided_detection_OwlV: post_process_image_guided_detection on OwlViTProcessor to convert image-guided detection output into COCO-formatted bounding boxes with nms filtering
